'''Matt Sokol''' (also known as '''Matthew Sokol'''; forums handle '''MrPurple'''; GEMP handle '''Datalar''')<ref name="cc1" /><ref name="retro-85495">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85495 Registered Players - 96], 2025 Retro GEMPC, forum.starwarsccg.org (24 March 2025). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2025_Retro_GEMPC_Registered_Players_96_forum_t85495 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t85495 2025 Retro GEMPC Registered Players.txt]]</ref><ref name="pcchart">PC organization chart PDF (created 6 May 2024), [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF]; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live PDF]</ref> is the 2000 SWCCG World Champion (DecipherCon) and a founding member of [[Team Albany]]. After the Final Confrontation he and [[Yannick Lapointe]] sat for a Decipher post-match interview.<ref name="dcon-iv">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (21 August 2018). Footage by Derek Brooks. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive].</ref> [[Trandosite]] interviewed him on 25 October 2000.<ref name="trando-iv16">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041026224145/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv16.htm Matt Sokol interview], [[Trandosite]] (25 October 2000)</ref> On 6 May 2025 he sat for a later video interview looking back at that championship and his Hidden Base X-wing Numbers and ISB Sandwhirl lists.<ref name="pds2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jFXqTc1jkNc SWCCG PDS2: Matt Sokol, Worlds 2000 Champion Interview, HB X-wing Numbers, ISB Sandwhirl], BillBisco2 (6 May 2025). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-jFXqTc1jkNc Internet Archive].</ref>

[[File:Matt Sokol DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Sokol at [[DecipherCon 2000]] after the [[Team Albany]] team win]]

== Interviews ==

''Main article: [[Matt Sokol/Interviews]]''

Sokol has been interviewed on video at DecipherCon 2000, by [[Trandosite]] (2000), and on Kendall's CorranCast (2020).<ref name="dcon-iv" /><ref name="trando-iv16" /> A 2025 video covers his 2000 title and his [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] trip.<ref name="pds2" />
